function.name: VDP_WriteTileWord
behavior: Indexes the VDP tile-row command table at 0x00FF8680 from the caller's row selector.
Combines the caller's word offset with the row command and writes the resulting VDP control value.
Combines the caller's tile word with the scene/resource base at 0x00FFEFF0 and writes it through VDP_DATA.
Preserves the caller's D0/D2 and D1/A0 working registers.

conclusion: The scene command stream delegates its single-word VDP tile write to a reusable primitive rather than embedding the control-address and tile-base calculation in the command loop.
